items.title: Last day to file objection (Einspruch) against fine notice
items.quote: Einspruch gegen diesen Bußgeldbescheid können Sie innerhalb von zwei Wochen nach seiner Zustellung einlegen.
items.computation: Formal service (Zustellungsurkunde) is noted as 08.11.2025, so that is the delivery day (no 3-day fiction for formal service). Period starts the next day (§ 187 (1) BGB) and two weeks end on the same weekday: Saturday 22.11.2025 (§ 188 (2) BGB). That is a Saturday, so it moves to the next working day, Monday 24.11.2025 (§ 193 BGB, § 43 StPO via § 46 OWiG). The objection must reach the Bußgeldstelle by then.

items.title: Pay fine of 128.50 EUR after the notice becomes final
items.quote: Sobald der Bescheid rechtskräftig ist, haben Sie für die Zahlung des Gesamtbetrags zwei Wochen Zeit; geben Sie als Verwendungszweck bitte das Aktenzeichen an.
items.computation: Payment period starts when the notice becomes final. If no objection is filed, it becomes final when the objection period ends on 24.11.2025. The two weeks start on 25.11.2025 and end on Tuesday 09.12.2025. If an objection is filed, this date does not apply. The exact date of finality is not stated in the letter.

warnings: The payment deadline depends on the date the notice becomes final, which the letter does not state; 09.12.2025 assumes no objection is filed and finality after 24.11.2025.
Delivery is noted on a Saturday (08.11.2025); check that this matches the date you actually received the letter, because the objection deadline runs from the real delivery date.
The letter gives a 1-point entry in the Fahreignungsregister; an objection must reach the authority in writing or be recorded in person before the deadline.
